scope: Linux Runtime P0: WSL 2 discovery, fixed Node transport, Work Unit durability and interrupted-run recovery.

verification.truth: The WSL transport was exercised through a deterministic test adapter on Linux. A live Windows 11 and WSL 2 retest remains required.

implemented: Detect wsl.exe without shell and pin its SHA-256.
Decode UTF-16 WSL output and enumerate observed WSL 1/2 distributions.
Select only an explicit WSL 2 distribution.
Run only a fixed wsl.exe --distribution <distro> --exec node contract inside a Work Unit.
Persist PREPARED, RUNNING, EXECUTED, FAILED, CANCELLED and INTERRUPTED states.
Recover an unfinished RUNNING state as INTERRUPTED after restart.
Keep Linux Runtime internal to Electron main with no renderer process API.
blockedOrPending: Live Windows 11 and WSL 2 execution retest.
Windows Job Object or equivalent proof for the full WSL process tree.
Enforced network isolation for Linux tasks.
WSL ext4-managed Work Units and manifest-based synchronization.
Agent runtime admission and task execution for Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode.
User interface for Linux target status and Work Units.
Final Windows installer rebuild and retest.
